nodes.name: DHBT electrodeposition of Ni/CeOx (2 A)
nodes.procedure: A deposition bath was prepared by dissolving NiSO4 and Ce(NO3)3 together in Milli-Q water (concentrations 0.027 M and 0.003 M respectively), while (NH4)2SO4 (0.600 mM) was dissolved separately before mixing. A two-electrode cell was utilized with a 9 cm2 graphite plate anode and a 1 cm2 pressed (3000 psi) Ni foam cathode. A current density of 2 A cm-2 was applied for 7.5 min.

nodes.name: DHBT electrodeposition of Ni film
nodes.procedure: A Ni film was deposited from a solution containing 0.030 M NiSO4 and 0.600 mM (NH4)2SO4. The same cell configuration as Ni/CeOx preparation was used (graphite anode, pressed Ni foam cathode). A current density of 2 A cm-2 was applied for 7.5 min.
nodes.source_text: A Ni film was deposited from a solution containing 0.030 M NiSO4 and 0.600 mM (NH4)2SO4... 2 A cm-2, for 7.5 min, was the only applied current density.

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of CeOx film
nodes.procedure: The CeOx film was deposited under conditions identical to those of the Ni film (graphite anode, Ni foam cathode, 2 A cm-2, 7.5 min) but the NiSO4 was replaced with Ce(NO3)3 maintaining the concentration of 0.030 M.
nodes.source_text: The CeOx film was deposited under conditions identical to those of the Ni film and the only variation was the replacement of NiSO4 with Ce(NO3)3, maintaining the same concentration of 0.030 M.

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of Ni-Fe-Zn
nodes.procedure: A deposition bath comprised 0.050 M NiSO4, 0.050 M FeSO4, 0.050 M ZnSO4, 0.200 M trisodium citrate, and 1.0 M NH4Cl in Milli-Q water. All salts were dissolved together. A current density of 2 A cm-2 was applied for 7.5 min using the same two-electrode cell configuration (graphite anode, pressed Ni foam cathode).
nodes.source_text: The Ni–Fe–Zn film was prepared from a deposition bath that comprised 0.050 M NiSO4, 0.050 M FeSO4, 0.050 M ZnSO4, 0.200 M trisodium citrate, and 1.0 M NH4Cl... current density of 2 A cm-2 was applied for 7.5 min.

nodes.name: Dropcasting of Pt/C film
nodes.procedure: 5 mg of commercial Pt/C was mixed with 475 μL deionized water, 500 μL ethanol, and 25 μL of 5% PFSA dispersion binder. The ink was dropcast onto a 1 cm2 carbon fibre paper substrate.

(111) facet of cubic CeO2

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman spectra exhibit bands at 573 cm-1 (D band) and 1065 cm-1 (2LO band); the high ID/IF2g ratio indicates a high concentration of oxygen vacancies.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Raman spectroscopy confirms the resulting chemical structure, with Ni/CeOx (2 A) showing two bands at 573 and 1065 cm-1 corresponding to the defect-induced mode (D band) and the second-order longitudinal optical mode (2LO band) ... Ni/CeOx (2 A) exhibits the highest degree of defects.

nodes.characterization_summary: Surface and depth-profiling XPS confirm metallic Ni (Ni0) at depth and the presence of mixed Ce oxidation states (Ce3+ and Ce4+), supporting oxygen vacancies.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Deconvolution of the Ni 2p spectrum ... indicates that Ni is mostly metallic (Ni0) ... Ce 3d spectrum ... is deconvoluted into Ce3+ ions, which are related to the formation of O vacancies, and Ce4+ ions ... shift affirms the presence of metallic Ni and Ce oxides at deeper layers
